texts.zh:
[From.GetName]曾经拥有一个高等文明。但他们早已成为历史尘埃。异形猛兽在星球表面的远古战场上肆虐横行。

在石山地区的山脉底部藏有一个避难所。如果我们能先处理掉地表的猛兽，我们就可以继续调查。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] used to hold an advanced civilization. It is now dead silent. Alien beasts roam old battlefields that stretch across the surface.

In a rocky region there seems to lie a hidden vault beneath the mountains. If we could get rid of the beasts roaming the landscape we could investigate it.

label.en: Let's try and get to it!

label.zh: 远离避难所和在那里游荡的灵魂。
label.en: Leave the vault, and its wandering spirits be.

texts.zh:
清除猛兽后，我们进入了避难所。内部似乎是一间指挥室，为这个死亡文明的领袖们提供最后的庇护。

避难所内全是破损的设备和腐烂的尸体。唯一值得调查的是一个容器，可能装有十分重要的东西。
texts.en:
With the beasts removed, we could access the vault. Inside it lay a headquarter of sorts, a last refuge for a dying world's leaders.

The vault is filled with destroyed equipment and decomposed corpses. The only thing of interest being a container, which potentially holds something of importance.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.

label.zh: 以防万一，只研究避难所。
label.en: Only study the vault to avoid risks.

texts.zh:
在[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]上发现的容器原来是一个冷藏装置！封存的外星人已经苏醒。她用心灵感应说道：

“为什么叫醒我？我们一族的战争结束了吗？”
texts.en:
The container found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] turned out to be a cryogenic device! The preserved alien within has awoken. She speaks using telepathic concepts:

"Why have you brought me back, captor? Is the war of my people over?"

label.zh: 你目前在[HomePlanet.GetName]上。这里很安全。
label.en: You are on [HomePlanet.GetName]. You are safe here.

label.zh: 你的家乡被战争毁灭了，只有你幸存。
label.en: Your home planet was ruined by the war, only you remain.

label.zh: 我们尽力从你们被毁的家园抢救物资。
label.en: We salvaged what we could of your ruined homeworld.

label.zh: 极端唯心主义 · 唯心主义
极端平等主义 · 平等主义
极端唯物主义 · 唯物主义

texts.zh: “我就怕这种事发生。希望我的知识和我们种群的悲剧能带给别人教诲。”
texts.en: "I feared that this would happen. I only hope that my knowledge, and our failure as a species, can teach others."

label.zh: 在战时被冷冻，你一定是个重要人物？
label.en: To be frozen in war you must be of high value?

label.zh: 你是出于什么神圣的任务而被冷藏的吗？
label.en: Were you preserved for a divine mission?

label.zh: 离开吧。你的命运由你自己掌控。
label.en: Leave. Your fate is your own.
You are of no use to us. Leave!

label.zh: 极端军国主义 · 军国主义
极端唯物主义 · 唯物主义
极端排外主义 · 排外主义

texts.zh: “是这样吗……我就怕醒来时会得到这个消息。说实话，我更怕永远醒不过来。你们一族想从我这里获得什么？”
texts.en: "So that's why... I feared that I would wake up to these news. To be honest I feared I would never wake at all. What does your kind want of me?"

label.zh: 在战时被冷冻，你一定是个重要人物？
label.en: To be frozen in war you must be of high value?

label.zh: 你是出于什么神圣的任务而被冷藏的吗？
label.en: Were you preserved for a divine mission?

label.zh: 离开吧。你的命运由你自己掌控。
label.en: Leave. Your fate is your own.
You are of no use to us. Leave!

label.zh: 极端军国主义 · 军国主义
极端唯物主义 · 唯物主义
极端排外主义 · 排外主义

texts.zh: “你的话语和你的文明向我证明了一切，捕获者。我会加入你，希望你能吸取我们种群的教训。”
texts.en: "Your words, and your civilization speaks to me, captor. I will join you, in hopes that you will learn from my people's mistakes.

texts.zh: 你的话语，还有这个房间的氛围，都证明了我们的观点不合。所以我不会加入你。我会回到[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]，穷尽一生讲述它的故事。
texts.en: The way you speak. The way this room speaks for you. It tells me that our views do not align, captor. So no, I will not join you. I will return to [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName], and tell its stories for as long as I remain."

texts.zh:
“宁死不屈！”

玛居拉愤怒地冲出房间。外面的人群正准备进行阻拦，她就抓住了一名研究员作为人质。在逃离过程中，人质不幸牺牲而玛居拉也被警卫击毙。
texts.en:
"I would rather die!"

Majula runs out of the room, enraged. As a crowd had gathered outside to take part in the proceedings she grabs a researcher to use as leverage. In the escape, the researcher dies before Majula is gunned down by security.

texts.zh: “再见了，捕获者。试着吸取我们物种的教训，千万不要在我们下一次相遇时，你也成了你们物种的最后一人。”
texts.en: "Farewell, captor. Try and learn from what happened to my people, lest we meet again and you too have ended up to be the last of your kind."

texts.zh: 在[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]的地下避难所附近清除野兽时，战斗意外地导致了建筑崩塌。我们未能从残骸中回收到有价值的东西。
texts.en: Fighting off the beasts around the underground vault on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] has caused the complex to collapse. We are unable to salvage anything of value from the debris.

texts.zh: 打开[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]上发现的容器后，我们找到了一些健康作物的样本，还有一些辅助器材，这可以让样本在肥沃条件下重新生长。我们可以用逆向工程技术研究它。
texts.en: Opening up the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] revealed it to hold samples of healthy crops, as well as instruments that would help it grow again in infertile conditions. We could reverse engineer this.

texts.zh:
打开[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]上发现的容器后，我们找到了一些健康作物的样本，还有一些辅助器材，这可以让样本在肥沃条件下重新生长。.

虽然意义不大，但这个文明的文化历史数据可以让我们更了解他们的真面目。
texts.en:
Opening up the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] revealed it to hold samples of healthy crops, as well as instruments that would help it grow again in infertile conditions..

While not being that useful to us, there were also data on the civilization's culture and history, which could give us more insight into who they were.

texts.zh:
打开[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]上发现的容器后，我们才意识到那是一个生物武器的发射器。

这种生物武器专门降低目标的生殖能力，并且扩散迅速。不过和我们的遗传因子不兼容，所以不会影响我们种群的数量。
texts.en:
After opening the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] we were shocked to realize that it was a dispenser for a biological weapon!

The bio-weapon was made to target fertility functions and quickly spreads. It is however not entirely compatible with our DNA, and will not cause us to diminish in numbers.

texts.zh: 我们在山体底下找到了一个可能包含宝贵信息或者装置的建筑物。它的周围有危险的野生动物，为了得到它我们需要制服这些野兽。
texts.en: We found a structure beneath a mountain which could contain valuable information or gear. It is surrounded by dangerous wildlife and we need to subdue these beasts in order to get to it.

texts.zh: 我们发现的避难所中存放着一个容器。如果我们想知道里面有什么，我们需要找到撬开它的最佳方法。
texts.en: The underground vault we found held only a container of sorts. We need to figure out how to best pry it open if we want to find out what is inside.
